_comment: Optional 'host_checks' section of the deployment's private profile (P57). Keep the real file outside Git. check_bridge (true/false) overrides the default (checked when the profile's projects include drive); set it when the checks are rendered from a profile without Drive on a server that runs Drive. alert (optional): the dedicated alert sender that mails the admin when the boot check repaired or failed something (P57); the password stays in its root-only file on the server. alert.address (optional, an IP address): connect there instead of smtp_host, for a server that cannot reach its own mail server under the certificate's name (for example only on its tailnet address); the certificate is still verified for smtp_host (P57).
